in_hebrew.name: Rodger
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Rodger הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word 'rod' meaning 'fame, renown,' and 'ger' meaning 'spear.' This name was popular among the Anglo-Saxons and Normans, and was borne by several early English kings. The name was also borne by a saint, St. Rodger of Lindisfarne.

in_greek.name: Rodger
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Famous ruler
in_greek.long_meaning: Rodger είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old English word 'rod' meaning 'fame, renown,' and 'ger' meaning 'spear.' This name was popular among the Anglo-Saxons and Normans, and was borne by several early English kings. The name was also borne by a saint, St. Rodger of Lindisfarne.
